type.label: Promo: Image + Text
type.description: Image on the left, heading, text and a button on the right; optional dark band, big line and ticker. Stacks on mobile.

field.name: image
field.label: Image
field.description: Shown at its own proportions: half the width on desktop, full width on mobile.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the image shows, for screen readers. Leave empty if it only decorates.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: A line break here is a line break on the page, e.g. "Introducing the" / "Elme Outlet".

field.name: text
field.label: Text
field.description: One to three short paragraphs. Bold for the offer.

field.name: button_label
field.label: Button label
field.description: Two or three words. Leave empty for no button.

field.name: button_link
field.label: Button link
field.description: Also links the image. e.g. /outlet-and-clearance-store

field.name: tone
field.label: Look
field.description: Dark: a charcoal band with white text, for a loud promo like the Outlet.

field.name: highlight
field.label: Big line
field.description: Optional. Shown very large under the heading, e.g. "Up to 80% off". Keep it short.

field.name: ticker
field.label: Ticker
field.description: Optional. One short item per line; they run slowly in a strip under the block, e.g. End-of-lines / Samples / One-off pieces.

type.label: Hero Banner / Slider
type.description: Full-width photo with a heading, text and a button. Add more slides for a slider.

field.name: is_page_title
field.label: First heading is the page H1
field.description: Turn on only when this hero is the top banner of the page and nothing else on the page has the H1 (About, Careers, Outlet, and the home page when Welcome uses the Intro look).

field.name: autoplay
field.label: Play slides automatically
field.description: Only with more than one slide. Stops on hover and focus, has a pause button, and stays off for visitors who turned off animations.

field.name: interval
field.label: Seconds per slide
field.description: How long each slide stays when it plays automatically, 4 to 15.

field.name: slides
field.label: Slides
field.description: One slide is a plain banner; two to five become a slider. Remove a dated campaign (a trade fair) once it is over.

field.name: image_desktop
field.label: Desktop image
field.description: Photo only: no words in the image, write them in Heading and Text. JPEG or WebP, not GIF, about 300 KB, 2:1. The text sits on the left 55%, so keep the subject on the right.

field.name: image_mobile
field.label: Mobile image
field.description: Photo only, JPEG or WebP, about 150 KB, 4:5 portrait. The text sits on the bottom half. Leave empty to use a centre crop of the desktop image.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the photo shows (product, room, material). Do not repeat the heading. Empty only if purely decorative.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: Live text that search and AI read: say what Elme sells or offers ("Made to Order Sofas, Built for Your Store"), not a mood line ("New Season"). Each line break is a line on the page and rises on its own; two or three short lines look best.

field.name: tone
field.label: Photo tone
field.description: Dark photo: white text on a dark fade. Light photo: dark text on a light fade.

field.name: text
field.label: Text
field.description: One or two plain sentences of fact: trade only, ABN, Melbourne showrooms. No prices, MOQ numbers or ratings.

field.name: button_label
field.label: Button label
field.description: Name the destination: "Shop Made to Order Sofas", "Visit Our Showrooms", not "Learn more".

field.name: button_link
field.label: Button link
field.description: Also links the photo. Relative, no tracking parameters, e.g. /made-to-order-sofas.html

type.label: Category Tiles Carousel
type.description: Category tiles (image + name): a row that scrolls (arrows on desktop, swipe on mobile) or a grid of all tiles.

field.name: heading
field.label: Section heading
field.description: Optional title above the tiles, e.g. "Shop by category". Leave empty for none. Never the page H1.

field.name: layout
field.label: Layout
field.description: Carousel: one row that scrolls. Grid: every tile at once, two per row on phones and four from desktop (best with 4, 8 or 12 tiles).

field.name: tiles
field.label: Tiles
field.description: One row per category. About eight to twelve fit the home page.

field.name: link
field.label: Category link
field.description: Canonical category path, no tracking parameters. e.g. /homewares/vessels.html

field.name: label
field.label: Label
field.description: Name on the tile: Vessels, Decor, Floral Stems, Bouquets & Bundles... May differ from the Magento name.

field.name: image
field.label: Image
field.description: Lifestyle photo for the category. JPEG or WebP, no words in the image: the Label field is the text.

type.label: Welcome + CTA
type.description: Statement: heading (page H1 on home), short wholesale line, apply button and Log in. Intro: a short lead with trade facts under a hero that holds the H1. No image.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading (page H1 in the Statement look)
field.description: Stable brand + wholesale identity. On the home page this is the only visible H1. e.g. "Wholesale artificial flowers, plants and home decor for Australian retailers".

field.name: text
field.label: Text
field.description: One guest-visible wholesale line: trade login for prices / apply with ABN. Plain sentences; no prices, MOQ numbers, reviews or ratings.

field.name: button_label
field.label: Button label
field.description: e.g. "Become a Stockist". Descriptive, not "Learn more".

field.name: button_link
field.label: Button link
field.description: Guest destination, e.g. /become-a-stockist. Hidden for logged-in customers.

field.name: look
field.label: Look
field.description: Statement: the heading is the page H1, large, with the apply and Log in buttons. Intro: a short lead under a hero that holds the H1, the text and up to four trade facts, no buttons.

field.name: facts
field.label: Trade facts (Intro look)
field.description: Shown in the Intro look only: what a shop owner needs to know, e.g. ABN trade account, prices ex GST, Australia-wide delivery.

type.label: Catalogue Covers
type.description: Heading and intro with a list of catalogue covers (name and a short line) and an optional See All link. Hides when there are no covers.

field.name: heading
field.label: Section heading
field.description: Section title as H2, e.g. "Curated Catalogues". Never the page H1.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Optional short plain text under the heading. Keep it about catalogues as buying tools.

field.name: cards
field.label: Cover cards
field.description: One to four covers. Distinct links per card (Lookbook vs Virtual Catalogues; in the Photo cards look also the Outlet). Empty or missing images hide the whole band.

field.name: image
field.label: Cover image
field.description: Cover art JPEG or WebP. No words baked into the image: the Title field is the text.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the cover shows, or match the card title.

field.name: title
field.label: Title
field.description: Visible card name: Lookbook, Virtual Catalogues...

field.name: text
field.label: Short line
field.description: Optional, under the title: what is inside, e.g. "Styled rooms and seasonal edits".

field.name: link
field.label: Link
field.description: Distinct per card. Lookbook -> /shop-the-looks; Virtual Catalogues -> /virtual-catalogues.

field.name: see_all_label
field.label: See all label
field.description: Optional. e.g. "See All Catalogues".

field.name: see_all_link
field.label: See all link
field.description: e.g. /virtual-catalogues. Leave empty for no button.

field.name: look
field.label: Look
field.description: Shelf: tilted covers on a sand band. Cards: equal photo cards with the title on the photo, on the page background (home "From the showroom": Outlet, Lookbook, Virtual Catalogues).

type.label: Shop the Looks
type.description: Lifestyle look images with product hotspots. Guests see name, image and View; signed-in buyers get price, stock, MOQ qty and add to cart.

field.name: layout
field.label: Layout
field.description: Gallery: every look with the room filter (the Shop the Looks page). Feature: one look under a section heading (home Be Inspired).

field.name: heading
field.label: Section heading (Feature)
field.description: e.g. Be Inspired. The look title sits under it.

field.name: feature_look
field.label: Look number (Feature)
field.description: Which look to show, counting from 1. A look that cannot show is skipped for the first one.

field.name: link_label
field.label: Link label (Feature)
field.description: e.g. Shop the Looks. Shown next to the heading.

field.name: link
field.label: Link (Feature)
field.description: e.g. /shop-the-looks

field.name: source
field.label: Use the looks of entry
field.description: Identifier of another Shop the Looks entry (e.g. shop-the-looks-gallery). Used when Looks below is empty, so the home block and the page share one set of looks.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Optional plain text under the page H1 (Gallery). Wholesale voice: styled looks for Australian retailers; sign in for Pronto prices.

field.name: looks
field.label: Looks
field.description: One lifestyle frame per row. Missing image or zero valid hotspots hide that look. Leave empty to use the looks of the entry above.

field.name: title
field.label: Look title
field.description: Visible H2 / figcaption, e.g. Dining vignette. Used for image alt when alt is empty.

field.name: room
field.label: Room
field.description: Shop by Room filter on /shop-the-looks.

field.name: image
field.label: Lifestyle image
field.description: Room vignette JPEG or WebP. Hotspot X/Y are percent of this frame.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the vignette shows. Defaults to the look title.

field.name: description
field.label: Short line
field.description: Optional line under the look title.

field.name: hotspots
field.label: Hotspots
field.description: Pins on the image. X and Y are percent from top-left. Missing SKU skips the pin.

field.name: x
field.label: X %
field.description: Horizontal position, 0 = left edge, 100 = right.

field.name: y
field.label: Y %
field.description: Vertical position, 0 = top edge, 100 = bottom.

field.name: sku
field.label: Product SKU
field.description: Magento SKU. Resolved on the server for name, image and PDP URL.

field.name: label
field.label: Pin label (optional)
field.description: Optional override for the accessible pin name. Defaults to the product name.

type.label: Virtual Catalogues
type.description: Seasonal wholesale catalogue covers. Guests see locked covers and trade CTAs; signed-in buyers open flipbooks and shop the range. Also used for Special Offers Catalogue.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Optional plain text under the page H1. Wholesale voice: seasonal catalogues for Australian trade customers. Shown to everyone when set.

field.name: guest_message
field.label: Guest sign-in message
field.description: Optional. Guests only (e.g. Sign in to see our brand new Special Offers Catalogue!). Hidden when signed in. Leave empty on the seasonal Virtual Catalogues page.

field.name: catalogues
field.label: Catalogues
field.description: One card per season. Cover + title are public; Open URL is never printed for guests. Editable in admin (FE-92 QA 2).

field.name: title
field.label: Season title
field.description: Visible card H2, e.g. SS27 or AW26.

field.name: description
field.label: Short line
field.description: Optional line under the title.

field.name: image
field.label: Cover image
field.description: Cover art JPEG or WebP. Title field is the text; do not bake words into the image.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: e.g. Elme Living SS27 catalogue cover. Defaults to the season title.

field.name: open_url
field.label: Open catalogue URL (logged in)
field.description: Issuu embed or PDF URL. Output only for signed-in customers. Never shown to guests or in guest JSON-LD.

field.name: shop_url
field.label: Shop this range URL (logged in)
field.description: Category or new-arrivals path. Output only when signed in. Leave empty to hide the secondary link.

field.name: shop_label
field.label: Shop link label
field.description: Defaults to Shop this range.

type.label: Instagram Slider (As styled by you)
type.description: Heading, @handle, Follow Us and a row of square stockist posts. Curated images from our media; no Instagram embed script.

field.name: heading
field.label: Section heading
field.description: Home/CMS H2. On a product page the template may replace this with "Styled by our stockists" when filtering by SKU. Never the page H1.

field.name: handle
field.label: Instagram handle
field.description: Without @. Links to https://www.instagram.com/{handle}/. Keep elmeliving in sync with the footer and FE-55 sameAs.

field.name: invite
field.label: Invite line
field.description: Short line next to Follow Us asking stockists to tag Elme. Leave empty to hide.

field.name: follow_label
field.label: Follow button label
field.description: Descriptive label for the profile link.

field.name: posts
field.label: Posts
field.description: Curated stockist posts. Marketing picks photos that show Elme stock in real shops. Zero rows hide the section.

field.name: image
field.label: Image
field.description: Square JPEG or WebP from our media (not a hotlinked Instagram CDN URL).

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the photo shows (caption). Required for linked images (UX-08).

field.name: post_url
field.label: Instagram post URL
field.description: Permalink for tiles without SKUs (View on Instagram). Absolute https URL.

field.name: credit_handle
field.label: Stockist handle
field.description: Without @. Shown under the tile, e.g. houseofsmith.

field.name: credit_location
field.label: Location
field.description: Optional, e.g. Bendigo VIC.

field.name: skus
field.label: Product SKUs
field.description: Optional. Comma-separated Magento SKUs. When set the tile links on-site (shoppable view / FE-68); when empty it says View on Instagram.

field.name: caption
field.label: Caption (optional)
field.description: Source for alt context. Not printed as a second heading.

type.label: USP Strip (Stockist benefits)
type.description: Image (or a three-photo collage) beside a heading, trade-fact rows and a button. Stacks on mobile.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: Section H2, e.g. "Become a Stockist".

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Optional short support copy under the heading.

field.name: image
field.label: Image
field.description: Side photo. JPEG or WebP. Shown above the text on phones, left on desktop.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the image shows. Leave empty if purely decorative.

field.name: image_2
field.label: Collage photo 2
field.description: Optional. With photo 3 as well, the side image becomes a three-photo collage that moves with the mouse on desktop. Landscape works best.

field.name: image_3
field.label: Collage photo 3
field.description: Optional, see photo 2. Both or none.

field.name: items
field.label: Trade facts
field.description: Facts a shop owner needs before applying (ABN, prices ex GST, delivery / MOQ). Not lifestyle fluff.

field.name: title
field.label: Fact title
field.description: e.g. "ABN trade account", "Prices ex GST", "Australia-wide delivery".

field.name: text
field.label: Fact detail
field.description: One plain sentence. No invented price figures or star ratings.

field.name: show_items
field.label: Show the trade facts
field.description: Turn off when the same facts are already on the page (the home intro), so the block is just photos, heading, intro and button.

field.name: button_label
field.label: Button label (guests)
field.description: e.g. "Create An Account". Logged-in customers see My Account instead.

field.name: button_link
field.label: Button link (guests)
field.description: e.g. /customer/account/create. Logged-in customers go to the account dashboard.

type.label: FAQs Accordion
type.description: Grouped FAQ accordion for /faqs: topic jump strip, find-as-you-type filter, keyboard and #anchor open.

field.name: items
field.label: Questions
field.description: One row per question. Topics: Location, Orders, Payments, Shipping, Marketing (production parity).

field.name: topic
field.label: Topic
field.description: Groups the accordion and the jump strip. Use Shipping (not Delivery).

field.name: anchor
field.label: Anchor slug
field.description: Stable # deep link, e.g. do-you-have-a-minimum-order. Leave empty to derive from the question. Do not change a published slug without a redirect note.

field.name: question
field.label: Question
field.description: Plain question text shown on the accordion control (and in FAQ JSON-LD).

field.name: answer
field.label: Answer
field.description: Trade facts only (MOQ, freight, GST, showroom). No invented prices or ratings. Links as real <a href>.

field.name: next_step
field.label: Trade next-step link
field.description: Optional clear exit under the answer. Guests vs logged-in href is chosen on the server.

field.name: show_on_pdp
field.label: Show on product pages
field.description: Adds the question to the Trade FAQ row of every product page. Keep it to 5 to 7 ordering, freight and account questions.

type.label: Proof Pillars
type.description: Image beside a section heading and proof rows (title, one line, one link). Stacks on mobile.

field.name: heading
field.label: Section heading
field.description: Section H2, e.g. "Why stockists choose Elme". Never the page H1.

field.name: image
field.label: Image
field.description: Side photo. JPEG or WebP. Above the text on phones, left on desktop.

field.name: image_alt
field.label: Image alt text
field.description: What the image shows. Leave empty if purely decorative.

field.name: items
field.label: Proofs
field.description: Retailer proofs (new range, BDM advice, wholesale account), not lifestyle fluff.

field.name: title
field.label: Title
field.description: Short H3, e.g. "New and exclusive lines".

field.name: text
field.label: One line
field.description: One plain sentence. No prices, ratings or invented figures.

field.name: link_label
field.label: Link label
field.description: Topic of the link, e.g. "Shop New", "Meet the Team".

field.name: link
field.label: Link
field.description: e.g. /new.html, /meet-the-team, /become-a-stockist.

type.label: Stockist CTA
type.description: Centred band: heading, short line, primary Create an Account (My Account when logged in) and secondary Talk to our team.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: Section H2, e.g. "Become a stockist".

field.name: text
field.label: Support line
field.description: Optional. One plain sentence under the heading.

field.name: primary_label
field.label: Primary label (guests)
field.description: e.g. "Create an Account". Logged-in customers see My Account instead.

field.name: primary_link
field.label: Primary link (guests)
field.description: e.g. /customer/account/create.

field.name: secondary_label
field.label: Secondary label
field.description: e.g. "Talk to our team".

field.name: secondary_link
field.label: Secondary link
field.description: e.g. /meet-the-team.

type.label: Store: Visit Us Card
type.description: Store name, address with Get directions, phone and opening hours. Address and phone come from store config.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: Card heading (H2), e.g. "Visit us".

field.name: store_name
field.label: Store name
field.description: Full name, the same everywhere (page H1, store locator, Google profile): "Elme Living Outlet & Clearance Store". Also the name in search results.

field.name: intro
field.label: What the store is
field.description: One plain sentence: what is sold there. Search engines use it as the store description.

field.name: public_note
field.label: Who can visit
field.description: Short line, e.g. "Open to the public, no trade account needed". Leave empty for a trade-only showroom.

field.name: schema_type
field.label: Kind of store
field.description: For search engines only. Outlet for the clearance store.

field.name: hours
field.label: Opening hours
field.description: One row per run of days with the same hours: Mon to Sat 09:00-17:00, then Sun 10:00-17:00. Days not listed show as closed to search engines.

field.name: day_to
field.label: To
field.description: Leave on "Only that day" for a single day.

field.name: opens
field.label: Opens
field.description: 24-hour time, e.g. 09:00

field.name: closes
field.label: Closes
field.description: 24-hour time, e.g. 17:00

type.label: FAQ: Short List
type.description: Heading and a few questions that open and close. Plain text answers.

field.name: heading
field.label: Heading
field.description: Section heading (H2), e.g. "Good to know".

field.name: items
field.label: Questions
field.description: Three to six short questions. Search engines and AI answers read them word for word.

field.name: question
field.label: Question
field.description: As a customer would ask it, e.g. "Is the outlet open to the public?".

field.name: answer
field.label: Answer
field.description: Plain sentences, facts first. A blank line starts a new paragraph.

field.name: anchor
field.label: Link name
field.description: Optional. The #name for a direct link to this question, e.g. open-to-the-public. Leave empty to make one from the question.

type.label: Meet the Team
type.description: Page H1, intro, region filter chips and a grid of people (photo, role above name, email and phone links).

field.name: title
field.label: Page heading (H1)
field.description: The only H1 on /meet-the-team. Match the CMS page title / footer label.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Plain facts: who Elme Living is (Australian B2B wholesaler), that this page lists sales and showroom contacts by region, and that trade prices need a stockist account (/become-a-stockist). No prices or MOQ amounts.

field.name: heading
field.label: Grid heading (H2)
field.description: Optional H2 above the cards, e.g. Our account managers. Leave empty for none.

field.name: people
field.label: People
field.description: One card per person. Switch off or delete when someone leaves. Publish only people with real email and phone — do not invent contacts.

field.name: photo
field.label: Photo
field.description: Headshot, square. Alt text is the person name. JPEG or WebP.

field.name: name
field.label: Name
field.description: Shown as the card H3.

field.name: role
field.label: Role
field.description: Small text above the name, e.g. VIC Business Development Manager. Not a heading.

field.name: email
field.label: Email
field.description: Shown as a mailto link. Leave empty if unknown — never invent.

field.name: phone
field.label: Phone
field.description: Shown as a tel link. Prefer mobile with +61; office landlines are fine.

field.name: region
field.label: Region
field.description: Chip filter and card label. Head office for national / Blackburn roles.

field.name: is_visible
field.label: Show on the page
field.description: Switch off to hide without deleting the row.

type.label: Fairs & Events
type.description: Upcoming trade fairs and showroom events. Past end dates leave the page automatically; with none left, one empty message and a showroom link.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Plain facts above the list: who Elme Living is (Australian B2B wholesaler), what this page is (trade fairs where retailers meet the team), and how to book (Meet the Team / Blackburn showroom). No prices or MOQ numbers.

field.name: heading
field.label: List heading
field.description: H2 above the list and above the empty message, e.g. Upcoming fairs. Never the page H1.

field.name: empty_text
field.label: Empty message
field.description: Shown when every fair has ended. The Blackburn showroom link is added after it, so do not repeat that here.

field.name: items
field.label: Events
field.description: One row per fair. An event whose end date has passed is left out of the page and the schema entirely (Melbourne calendar day, no cache flush needed).

field.name: name
field.label: Event name
field.description: Visible H3, e.g. Reed Gift Fair. Used for the stable schema id with the start date.

field.name: start
field.label: Start date
field.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (Melbourne). Day + month of this date form the left date block.

field.name: end
field.label: End date
field.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD inclusive. Hidden the Melbourne day after this date.

field.name: city
field.label: City
field.description: e.g. Melbourne. Shown as text under the name, not as a heading.

field.name: venue
field.label: Venue
field.description: e.g. Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre.

field.name: stand
field.label: Stand
field.description: Optional stand / booth number, e.g. A12.

field.name: text
field.label: Short description
field.description: Optional plain sentence under the venue. No prices.

field.name: link
field.label: Fair website
field.description: Optional absolute http(s) URL to the fair's own site. The card CTA stays Book a time with your rep (Meet the Team).

type.label: Careers: Open Roles
type.description: Intro, then the open roles with an Apply by email link each. With no roles shown, one no-vacancies message and the careers address.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: Plain facts that stay true with or without open roles: who Elme Living is, which teams hire (sales, customer service, showroom, warehouse), where (Blackburn showroom, Tarneit distribution centre) and how to apply.

field.name: heading
field.label: Roles heading
field.description: Heading (H2) above the roles and above the no-vacancies message, e.g. "Current vacancies".

field.name: email
field.label: Careers email
field.description: The one address applications go to, shown once on the page. A role can have its own address below.

field.name: empty_text
field.label: No vacancies message
field.default: We have no vacancies right now, but we are always glad to hear from people who love design and service.
field.description: Shown when no role is switched on. The careers address and "send your resume and a short cover letter" are added after it, so do not repeat them here.

field.name: roles
field.label: Open roles
field.description: One row per open role. Switch a role off, or delete it, as soon as it is filled: it then leaves the page completely.

field.name: title
field.label: Role title
field.description: The job title people search for, e.g. "Showroom Sales Consultant", not "We're hiring!".

field.name: state
field.label: State
field.description: Shown in full on the page (Victoria).

field.name: email
field.label: Apply to (email)
field.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the careers email above.

field.name: is_open
field.label: Show on the page
field.description: Switch off when the role is filled or on hold.

type.label: Collaboration / Shop the Look
type.description: Campaign landing: optional banner, title and intro, lifestyle image, then a Shop the look product grid. Products are picked by SKU and render on the shared product card.

field.name: banner_desktop
field.label: Banner (desktop)
field.description: Full-width top banner on desktop (production Three Birds: 1920x700 with campaign logo). Leave empty only for text-first collabs with no hero.

field.name: banner_mobile
field.label: Banner (mobile)
field.description: Full-width top banner under md (production Three Birds: 450x240). Leave empty to use the desktop banner on phones.

field.name: banner_alt
field.label: Banner alt text
field.description: What the banner shows (campaign / partner). Empty only if decorative.

field.name: heading
field.label: Title
field.description: Centered page title under the banner, e.g. THREE BIRDS RENOVATIONS MAISON SOLEIL. This is the page H1 when is_page_title is on.

field.name: is_page_title
field.label: Title is the page H1
field.description: Turn on when this entry is the main body of the CMS page and nothing else has the H1.

field.name: intro
field.label: Intro
field.description: One or two plain sentences under the title. Wholesale voice: what the collab is and what to shop.

field.name: collage
field.label: Lifestyle collage
field.description: Optional tall photo / collage under the intro (production Three Birds). Leave empty for text-only intros.

field.name: collage_alt
field.label: Collage alt text
field.description: What the collage shows. Defaults to the title.

field.name: section_heading
field.label: Grid heading
field.description: Centered H2 above the product grid, e.g. Shop the look.

field.name: products
field.label: Products
field.description: Shop the look grid. Order here is order on the page. Missing, disabled or not-visible SKUs are skipped.

field.name: sku
field.label: Product SKU
field.description: Magento SKU. Resolved on the server for the shared product card (name, image, price, PDP).
